note: Authority Twitter/X posts — summarized with link. Verify on original tweet; not official confirmation.

items.title: MoFA Nepal
items.summary: @MoFANepal posted that flash floods struck the Bhote Koshi River area on 26 August, with 538 bodies recovered so far and 511 of 632 people from 33 countries still missing, while search and rescue continues. This is not official confirmation.

items.title: MoFA Nepal
items.summary: @MoFANepal posted a notice about an Emergency Control Room (ECR) for foreign nationals affected by the Bhote Koshi flash flood in Rasuwa, listing hotlines/WhatsApp +977-9744441227 and +977-9744441228 (7am–10pm), email emergency@mofa.gov.np, and updates at mofa.gov.np/category/flashflood/. This is not official confirmation of the notice's status or details.

items.title: MEA India
items.summary: @MEAIndia posted about a Special Control Room in MEA for Nepal Floods Situation, listing contact numbers (+91-11-23088718, +91-11-23088719), WhatsApp (+91-9968291988), and email (situationroom@mea.gov.in) for families of Indian nationals. This is not official confirmation of any events.

items.title: NDRRMA Nepal
items.summary: @NDRRMA_Nepal states that rescue and coordination updates for the Bhotekoshi / Rasuwa flash flood are published on the NDRRMA rescue portal and SETU platform. It advises families to use the official channels at ndrrma.gov.np/np/rescue and setu.ndrrma.gov.np.

items.title: Nepal Police HQ
items.summary: @NepalPoliceHQ states that Nepal Police’s Unified Database (UDB) publishes official found, missing, and unidentified remains lists for flood-affected areas at udb.nepalpolice.gov.np and warns against relying on unofficial social media posts. This is not an official confirmation of any individual’s status.

items.title: Embassy of India Kathmandu
items.summary: @IndiainNepal reports that the Embassy of India, Kathmandu is coordinating with Nepalese authorities on search and rescue for Indian nationals affected by flash floods in the Rasuwa/Bhotekoshi area and directs people to contact the MEA control room or Embassy for assistance.
